messages.subject: summer student assistant position
parts:
Hi R-users,

The Data Management Program at the UC Davis library is looking to hire a student assistant with R and data management skills for our pilot STRIDE (Successful Transformation of a Research Idea into Data Engagement) incubator this summer. The posting is on Aggie Job Link https://ucdavis-csm.symplicity.com/students/index.php?s=jobs&ss=jobs&mode=form&id=5f5681ca66912d0dc5f091e676fee234 or you can search by job id 839980.
Let me know if you have any questions (or have trouble accessing the post).

 

Vessela Ensberg

Associate Director, Data Management Program

Data and Digital Scholarship Department

UC Davis Library
